scope: Small software-only viability fork; no actuator or camera access
controlled_inputs: Saved per-arm starts, one saved camera scene, exact destination joint poses, models, collision margins, zones and timing policies
retention_reason: Low prior collapsed route alternatives and failed all cases. Moderate and broad priors both helped, but neither alone dominated. Combining them uses the same settings and geometry/clearance ranking for every task. Stronger tip regularization lost right R1/R2 feasibility, so it was not retained. A final stronger joint/posture penalty also lost R1/R3 feasibility; tuning stopped rather than starting a larger search.
limitation: All four available destinations were used during development; there is no held-out generalization claim. Only one left-arm destination is available. Clearance is a 5 mm padding-band proxy, not certified exact physical distance.
